title: Start and seed the backend
user_visible_behavior: Run and test the project from a clean checkout
verification_command: PRD section 12 command sequence succeeds and /docs lists section 7 endpoints
evidence: uv sync installed 45 packages including greenlet. .env.example parsed with Settings and its asyncpg URL, JSON CORS list, BLOB_DIR and LOG_LEVEL were verified. Ruff check/format and mypy passed; PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector 0.8.7 online Alembic upgrade passed; database-backed pytest 4/4 with 0 skipped and 0 leftover test schemas. Verified 28 entity tables, 59 foreign keys, vector columns, migration revision, mutable updated_at fields, upgrade/downgrade cleanup, and alembic check: No new upgrade operations detected.
notes: Phase 01 code review approved. Project Compose PostgreSQL remains healthy; disposable verification containers were stopped. Phase 02 is also complete and review approved.

title: Get recommendations and validation results
user_visible_behavior: Receive explanations for recommendations and validation
verification_command: Pipeline returns breakdown and fallback tier; V02 blocks prove with single_study
evidence: Phase 03 unit tests 29 passed; Phase 04 HTTP/API integration tests 16 passed; full PostgreSQL-backed suite 63 passed. Ruff check/format, mypy, and fresh-process pure-import checks pass.
notes: Implements ordered recommendation gates, fallback deduplication and limit, weighted score breakdown, V01-V08 with shared-policy V02, and database-backed recommendation/validation endpoints with audit logs. Phases 03-04 code review approved.

title: Manage access and audit writes
user_visible_behavior: Control access and trace write operations
verification_command: Missing key returns 401; wrong role returns 403; writes produce audit events; plaintext key appears only once
evidence: Phase 02 identity tests and Phase 04 role/audit integration tests pass: client/reviewer/curator/admin hierarchy, API-key create/list/revoke, authenticated route access, and atomic audit writes.
notes: Policy loader validates versioned YAML; EvidencePolicy fails closed on unknown values. Seed CLI is idempotent. Last admin cannot be revoked and bootstrap recovers when existing admin keys are inactive. Phases 02-04 code review approved.

title: Ingest and mine text into sourced candidates
verification_command: Upload .txt and run worker; at least one Candidate has source_sentence_ids and no direct pattern/version writes
evidence: Phase 05 PostgreSQL integration and unit tests pass; upload→ingest→mine produces sourced candidates without pattern/version writes. License refusal, stale-lock recovery, concurrent claims, offsets, parser failures and blob compensation are verified. Final suite: 76 passed, 9 acceptance cases skipped; Ruff, format, mypy and diff checks pass.
notes: Phases 05-06 code review approved. Text parser is implemented; JATS and PDF remain explicit TODO stubs. Docs include the D3/D4 decisions and PRD traceability table.
